title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25k Strawberry Watermelon Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Watermelon balances soft, ripe Strawberry with fresh Watermelon for a smooth, easy-going fruit mix. The pairing offers gentle sweetness with a light, refreshing finish. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, this format pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can enjoy long-range MTL performance without refilling or coil changes. A mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt provide steady vapour, defined flavour and quick nicotine satisfaction in a compact, simple setup. From fruity to sweet – discover all flavours: Browse the full collection here How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
